header.title: The Visual Language of Atelier Verdant

body_sections.heading: Opening
body_sections.prose: Atelier Verdant's visual posture is restrained, classical, and unhurried. The system is built around generous negative space and a single accent. Decoration is a structural cost the brand cannot afford.

body_sections.heading: Color System
body_sections.prose: Two ink-deep darks, a cream ground, and a gold accent are the working palette. Color appears in proportion, never in saturation.

body_sections.heading: Typography
body_sections.prose: A serif with editorial gravity carries display, paired with a clean grotesque for body. Tracking is loose at small sizes, tight at display.

body_sections.heading: Visual Anti-Patterns
body_sections.prose: The brand will not look corporate, will not lean on gradients, will not animate transitions, and will not borrow imagery from sister categories of fast fashion or commodity housewares.

swatches.label: Gold
swatches.rationale: Accent. Used sparingly to dignify a moment.

body.rationale: Clean, technical, neutral. Carries long reading without fatigue.
